rationale: The Latin anchor *siliqua* specifically denotes the seed-pod of leguminous plants (a dehiscent fruit), directly matching pod.n.02. The other Latin anchors (*bulga* = leather bag/sack, *follis* = bellows/bag, *uter* = wineskin) confirm a general "bag/vessel" semantic range, but *siliqua* is the decisive botanical anchor pointing to the legume pod sense rather than the more generic vessel sense of pod.n.01.
